<thought>The 1H NMR data (11 H total) shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two sets of 2 H), a methoxy singlet (3 H) and an ethyl chain attached to a carbonyl (two triplets, 2 H each). This fits a para‑methoxy phenyl‑CH₂‑CH₂‑C(=O)OCH₃ structure. Its SMILES is “COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)OC”.</thought>
